_readme: Manifest of every designation dataset. build_data.py reads this file; no code changes are needed to add a dataset.
To add a new Opportunity Zone round: copy a 'program': 'QOZ' entry, give it a new id (lowercase letters, digits, underscore),
set effective_date / expires_date / tract_vintage / geocoder_vintage, point source_url and columns at the new file,
then run: python build_data.py --only <new id>. The report picks up every QOZ entry automatically.
geocoder_vintage must be a Census Geocoder vintage whose tract boundaries match the list (see README.md).
membership 'listed' = presence in the file means the tract qualifies; 'flag' = a column says yes/no for every tract.

datasets.name: Designated Qualified Opportunity Zones (2018 round)
datasets.authority: IRS Notice 2018-48 and Notice 2019-42 (CDFI Fund list updated Dec 14, 2018)
datasets.period_note: Designations were made April-June 2018 and run through Dec 31, 2028. Puerto Rico's deemed-designated tracts are generally reported to end Dec 31, 2027, but sources differ; verify Puerto Rico dates.
datasets.lookup_county_aliases_note: The Census 2010 geocoder still returns Bedford city, VA (51515), which merged into Bedford County (51019) in 2013; the 2018 list uses 51019. HUD's OZ layer carries both codes for tract 050100.

supplements.description: Treasury list of 2018 QOZs comprised entirely of a rural area (Notice 2025-50)
supplements.geoid_county_aliases_note: Treasury's rural file uses post-2015 county codes (Oglala Lakota SD 46102, Kusilvak AK 02158); the 2018 list uses the 2010 codes (Shannon 46113, Wade Hampton 02270).

datasets.map_label: CDFI Fund CIMS map, Opportunity Zone layer (2018 zones), centered on the address

datasets.name: Designated Qualified Opportunity Zones (2027 round)
datasets.authority: Treasury/IRS designations announced Nov 5, 2026 under IRC 1400Z-1 as amended by Pub. L. 119-21; Rev. Proc. 2026-14
datasets.period_note: Designated Nov 5, 2026; the designation period is Jan 1, 2027 through Dec 31, 2036. Boundaries are the 2020 census tracts (Rev. Proc. 2026-14, sec. 3.01(3)).
datasets.map_label: CDFI Fund CIMS public map for Opportunity Zones (search the address; this tool cannot prefill it)

datasets.name: NMTC Low-Income Community eligibility (2016-2020 ACS)
datasets.authority: CDFI Fund NMTC LIC data released Sept 1, 2023; required for QLICIs closing on or after Sept 1, 2024
datasets.period_note: LIC status under the CDFI Fund's poverty and median family income tests. Does not evaluate 'severely distressed' or targeted-population criteria.

columns.qualifies: Does Census Tract Qualify For NMTC Low-Income Community

extra_columns.mfi_ratio_to_benchmark: Census Tract Percent of Benchmarked Median Family Income

supplements.description: High Migration Rural County tracts (MFI at or below 85%), which also qualify as LICs

datasets.map_label: CDFI Fund CIMS map (NMTC layers), centered on the address

datasets.name: SBA HUBZone map (live point lookup, cached)
datasets.round_label: SBA HUBZone designations as shown on the official map on the query date
datasets.authority: SBA HUBZone map, maps.certify.sba.gov (designations last redrawn July 1, 2023; next full update July 2028)
datasets.period_note: Covers every HUBZone type the SBA map shows at that point: qualified census tracts, non-metropolitan counties, Indian lands, base closure areas, governor-designated areas, disaster areas and redesignated areas. Status is as of the query date shown.
datasets.map_label: SBA HUBZone map, pinned to the address

datasets.name: SBA HUBZone qualified census tracts (bulk file you supply)
datasets.period_note: Disabled by default: SBA's bulk tract files on data.gov stop at 2018 and were superseded by the July 1, 2023 redesignation. Enable only with a current SBA file.
